title: Exchange rates
description: Daily TCMB and ECB rates fetched by the worker, with manual overrides. Orders and journal entries freeze the rate of their day.
override_description: A manual rate wins over TCMB and ECB for that day and pair. Removing it brings the fetched value back.
priority_note: Order: manual > TCMB > ECB. A day without rates uses the previous day.
error: Exchange rates could not be loaded
brand_currency.title: Brands and currency
brand_currency.description: The brand currency is the price and order currency; organizations keep their own cari and ledger currency. Existing orders, caris and finance entries keep their own currency and frozen rate.
brand_currency.current: Price and order currency: {{currency}} · Local display currency: {{local}}
brand_currency.admin_only: Only a platform admin can change the brand currency.
brand_currency.change_description: Preview first: products without a price in the new currency, open (draft and pending) orders and the rates are listed. Without blockers you can apply the change.
brand_currency.summary: {{from}} → {{to}}: {{products}} active products, {{missing}} without a price, {{orders}} open orders.
brand_currency.rate_to_local_missing: No rate from the new currency to the local currency; order approvals would find no rate.
brand_currency.conversion_rate_missing: No rate from the old to the new currency; open orders cannot be repriced.
brand_currency.blockers_title: The change cannot be applied because
brand_currency.blocker.same_currency: The brand already uses this currency.
brand_currency.blocker.open_orders: There are open orders: choose "Reprice at today's rate" or close them.
brand_currency.blocker.missing_prices: Some products have no price in the new currency: use the price conversion tool or tick "Apply despite missing prices".
brand_currency.blocker.rate_to_local_mis: No rate from the new currency to the local currency; add one under Exchange rates first.
brand_currency.blocker.conversion_rate_m: No rate from the old to the new currency; open orders cannot be repriced.
brand_currency.no_blockers: No blockers; the change can be applied.
brand_currency.apply_confirm_body: New prices and orders use {{to}} instead of {{from}}. Approved orders, caris and finance entries do not change. The change is written to the activity log.
brand_currency.convert_description: Writes the {{currency}} price list (purchase, sale to distributor, recommended) in the new currency at today's rate as draft prices. They stay unused until the brand currency changes; you can adjust them in the catalog.
brand_currency.convert_summary: {{total}} products: {{create}} new, {{update}} to update, {{skip}} skipped (already priced).
brand_currency.convert_confirm_body: The {{from}} price list is converted to {{to}} prices at today's rate and written. The brand currency does not change; the run is written to the activity log.
brand_currency.converted: {{currency}} draft prices written: {{create}} new, {{update}} updated, {{skip}} skipped.
